name: Bath Stopper
description: A rubber bath stopper.

name: Daisy
description: They are edible.

name: Flying Flippo
description: A flippo that flies through the air with deadly precision.

name: Branch
description: A weak tree branch. Better than nothing.

name: Mjollnir
description: A god-forged hammer humming with thunder. Legends say only the worthy can wield it.

name: Knife
description: A small, concealable blade.

name: Leather Armor
description: Basic protection made from tanned hide.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocking iron rings provide solid protection.

name: Empty Vial
description: A small empty glass vial. Fill it at a pool.

name: Health Potion
description: A red liquid that restores health.

name: Speed Potion
description: A fizzing yellow liquid. Your feet feel lighter.

name: Phasing Potion
description: A shimmering liquid that seems to bend light.

name: Potion of Depredation
description: A murky black liquid. You feel weakened.

name: Strength Potion
description: A thick liquid that makes your muscles tingle.

name: Experience Potion
description: Glowing green. Wisdom flows into your mind.

name: Potion of Blindness
description: A near-black liquid. The world goes dark.

name: Potion of Translucence
description: You can see through your own hands.

name: Second Life
description: A miraculous mixture glowing with golden light.

name: Potion of Invulnerability
description: A gleaming liquid. Nothing can harm you.

name: Potion of Music
description: Ethereal music fills your mind as you drink.

name: Potion of Transformation
description: Your form shifts and changes in remarkable ways.

name: Mystery
description: An unidentified brew. No one knows what it will do.

name: Scroll of Teleportation
description: Mystic script that tears a hole in space.

name: Blank Scroll
scrollText: The words dissolve as you read them.
description: A rolled parchment with fading ink.

name: Fragment I
description: A weathered fragment of ancient parchment.

name: Fragment II
description: A weathered fragment of ancient parchment.

name: Fragment III
scrollText: The waves are crashing all over the place
description: A weathered fragment of ancient parchment.

name: Ericgrass (tm)
eatMessage: You devour the Ericgrass (tm) like a real Brachiosaurus.
description: A firm healthy and especially nutricious grass.

name: Petergras
eatMessage: Your health takes a big hit. Any other animal would have been killed.
description: A fragile looking grass, definitely unhealthy to eat.

name: Battle Axe
description: A heavy axe that cleaves through armour.

name: Garden Scissors
description: Surprisingly sharp garden shears.

name: Crutch
description: A wooden crutch repurposed as a bludgeon.

name: Clothespin
description: Clamps onto noses and fingers alike.

name: Clothespin Bomb
description: Careful!!.

name: Toilet Brush
description: Terrifying in the wrong hands.

name: Mirror Shield
description: Reflects spells and excessive pride.

name: Ninja Trousers
description: Extremely stealthy legwear.

name: Garden Glove
description: Protects against thorns and minor slashing.

name: Amulet
description: A glowing pendant of unknown origin.

name: Banana
description: A ripe banana. Explosive when thrown.

name: Orange
description: A juicy orange bursting with vitamins.

name: Pancakes
description: You eat an endless pile of cold pancakes.

name: Peanutbutter sandwich
description: You feel bigger and stronger.

name: Stroopwafels
description: Caramel-filled waffle cookies. A national treasure.

name: Speculaas
description: Spiced shortcrust biscuits. Festive and fortifying.

name: Speculaas
eatMessage: This speculaas tastes soft and sour. Yuck!
description: Spiced shortcrust biscuits. Festive and fortifying.

name: Sprits
description: Buttery shortbread cookies in a familiar shape.

name: Rex Stamp
scrollText: Rex leaps across the ancient lands.
description: A collectible stamp featuring Rex.

name: Stego Stamp
description: A collectible stamp featuring a stegosaurus.

name: Steam Stamp
scrollText: Full steam ahead into the unknown.
description: A collectible stamp featuring a steam engine.

name: Gold Coin
description: A shiny gold coin.

name: Bracers
description: Sturdy leather bracers protecting your forearms.

name: Crossbow
description: A mechanical bow with impressive range.

name: Gorget
description: A metal collar protecting the throat.

name: Helmet
description: A sturdy iron helmet.

name: Katana
description: A graceful curved blade of exceptional quality.

name: Mace
description: A heavy flanged club effective against armored foes.

name: Pick axe
description: A miner's tool.

name: Red Cape
description: A flowing red cape that grants minor protection and wards off heat.

name: Ring
description: A glittering magical ring.

name: Ring of Hastening
description: A vibrating golden ring. Increases movement speed when worn.

name: Ring of Famine
description: A cursed ring that gnaws at your hunger. Greatly increases the rate of hunger.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: A hazy ring that bends light. The world fades to black while worn — remove it to see again.

name: Ring of Cold Resistance
description: An icy blue ring. Provides resistance against cold.

name: Silver Sword
description: A finely crafted sword of pure silver.

name: Wand
description: A slender magical wand crackling with energy.

name: Blue vase
description: A valuable collectors item to collectors of blue vases.

name: Widget
description: Widget, Eric's second favorite plush. It's his birthday today!

name: Pancake
description: A single Dutch pancake. Thrown at a monster, it sticks over their eyes.

name: Juicy fish
eatMessage: You reluctantly eat the fish. Some other people would have loved it instead.
description: A juicy, fresh fish.

name: Mespilus germanica
eatMessage: You eat the rotten Mespilus germanica. Your head starts spinning!
description: An overripe squishy fruit.

name: Lego Brick
description: A small red lego brick. Stepping on it is agony.

name: Lego Brick
description: A small yellow lego brick. You feel it before you see it.

name: Lego Brick
description: A small blue lego brick. The pain is quite specific.

name: Clump of Clay
eatMessage: You eat the clay. Your flesh hardens against petrification.
description: A lump of earthy clay. Eating it coats your insides against the Watcher's gaze.

name: Paper wad
description: A crumpled paper ball. Not very deadly, but satisfying to throw.

name: Scroll of Alliance
scrollText: The monsters regard you as kin.
description: A parchment sealed with a golden emblem. Monsters become your allies.

name: Scroll of Cartography
scrollText: The entire map is revealed to you.
description: A detailed parchment covered in tiny symbols. Reveals the full map.

name: Scroll of Extinction
scrollText: A thunderous silence falls over the dungeon.
description: Dark crimson ink on black parchment. Gives the power to wipe an entire species.

name: Scroll of Knowledge
description: Shimmering cyan text on fine parchment. Teaches you a skill.

name: Scroll of Transport
scrollText: The world lurches and you are elsewhere.
description: Purple-tinged parchment that hums faintly. Teleports you to a random location.

name: Scroll of Time Stop
scrollText: The world holds its breath. Nothing moves but you.
description: Ice-white parchment that crackles with cold. Freezes all monsters in place.

name: Remote Control
description: A TV remote. Points infrared light at things.

name: Wet Tea Towel
description: A damp tea towel. Worn as protection, it keeps the heat at bay.

name: Scroll of Twelve Gates
scrollText: Twelve doorways open before you. Choose wisely.
description: Ancient parchment etched with twelve arched portals. Opens a gateway for monsters.

name: Rubber Boots
description: Sturdy green rubber boots. Prevents you from slipping in the mud.

name: Ancient Gong
description: A sacred ceremonial gong. Something stirs as you lift it...

name: Gong Mallet
description: A pair of mallets used to sound the magical Green Gong.

name: Gompie
description: An inflatable boat. It fits in your pocket!
